# Copilot Workspace Instructions

- Build and maintain the portfolio for Angadi Jyothsna as a premium, responsive single-page app.
- Keep personal content editable in structured data and configuration rather than hardcoded in the UI.
- Use verified facts only; do not invent certificates, awards, or project claims.
- Support dark and light themes, smooth interactions, and accessible layouts.
- Keep the resume path configurable and replaceable via the public resume folder.
- Ensure the site remains clean, recruiter-friendly, and easy to maintain.
